presentation.title: The Wishing Well
presentation.story: A Greeneling is hiding at the bottom of an open well. Just drop a stone in. Thirty-five tries say you can't.

label: unwinnable
claim: Proved: none of the shots this slingshot allows hits the target. Also proved: with the blocks taken away, some shot would hit it.
scope: The slingshot offers only the angles and powers on the sliders. Each tick the stone moves by its velocity, then gravity slows its climb; it stops at the first block, the target, the ground, or the edge of the world. The proof checks every allowed shot under exactly these rules, which are the Lean functions this game runs.
